description: Read DNS for the project's custom hostname after configure_custom_domain. Returns dns.www, dns.apex, and dns.next (a single next DNS step, or null when www CNAME is in place and apex has records). customDomainStatus stays pending after attach — poll dns.next until null. Do not use this to attach a domain. Read-only.

project_id.description: Hosting project UUID from create_project or list_projects.
